title: Diagnose overfill indications caused by missing dimension data (no photo eyes)
summary: Use this diagnostic when chute/tote fullness appears to be at/over thresholds (e.g., chutes closing or totes marked full) but the system does not have chute photo eyes/sensors. The source explains that fullness/closure decisions are driven by received weight and dimensions; if dimension data is missing or incomplete for sort induct/auto inducts, chutes can appear to overfill.
when_to_use: When support observes overfill/threshold behavior (e.g., chutes closing due to tote fullness) and the site/system is described as having no photo eyes/sensors at the chute, so fullness is based on weighted dimensions. Use to validate whether missing or incomplete dimension/weight data for the sort induct/auto inducts is the cause of the overfill indications.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as the only troubleshooting path when dimension data is confirmed complete; the source only provides the data-missing explanation and does not provide corrective steps beyond escalation.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the diagnostic check to determine whether dimension/weight data is missing or incomplete for the relevant sort induct/auto inducts, and correlate that with the overfill symptom described by the source.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the live system view/log/API area that shows whether dimension data is being received for the sort induct / auto inducts (the source references that the team can see they are 'not getting dim data' on their system).

system_preconditions: The site/system behavior matches the source constraint: there are no photo eyes/sensors at the chute; fullness decisions rely on weight and dimensions.

visual_references.description: Segment showing how parcels are sorted into a chute/tote, how tote fullness is determined from received dimension data scaled up/down, and the explicit statement: 'We don't have any photo eyes... just weighted dimensions' plus the note that missing dim data can make all shoots overfill.

steps.title: Confirm the source constraint: chute fullness is based on weighted dimensions (no photo eyes/sensors)
steps.purpose: Ensure the diagnostic is grounded in the correct sensing model; otherwise missing dimension data would not be a valid explanation for overfill indications.
steps.instruction: On the live system, treat chute/tote fullness and chute close behavior as driven by received weight and dimensions (not local chute photo eyes/sensors).
steps.expected_result: You can proceed with the diagnostic assumption that fullness/closure thresholds are computed from received weight/dimensions, consistent with the source statement that there are no photo eyes/sensors at the chute.
steps.healthy_condition: The site/system configuration aligns with 'no sensors at all, just weighted dimensions' for chute fullness decisions.
steps.failure_condition: The site actually has chute photo eyes/sensors that directly drive fullness/closure; in that case, missing dimension data may not explain the overfill symptom.

actions.label: Validate chute sensing model is 'no photo eyes/sensors'
actions.exact_action: Use the source constraint that there are no photo eyes/sensors at the chute; fullness uses weight and dimensions.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: 'We don't have any photo eyes... there's no sensors at all, just weighted dimensions' and 'they can see on their system that they're not getting dim data... all the shoots are overfilling'.

steps.title: Check whether dimension data is being received for the sort induct / auto inducts
steps.purpose: Determine whether the overfill symptom is consistent with missing/incomplete dimension data, which the source explicitly ties to overfilling behavior.
steps.instruction: Using the live system view/log/API area referenced by the source (where the team can see they are 'not getting dim data'), check whether dimension data is being received for the relevant sort induct / auto inducts that feed the chute/tote fullness calculation.
steps.expected_result: You identify whether dimension data is missing entirely or partially (e.g., height/length present but a second length missing, and/or weight missing) for the affected induct(s).
steps.healthy_condition: Dimension data is present for the relevant induct(s) such that fullness can be computed from received weight and dimensions.
steps.failure_condition: Dimension data is missing or incomplete for the relevant induct(s), matching the source explanation that this can cause chutes to appear to overfill.

actions.label: Verify 'dim data' reception status
actions.exact_action: Check on the live system whether the system is 'not getting dim data' for the sort induct / auto inducts.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: 'they can see on their system that they're not getting dim data... all the shoots are overfilling' and describes missing dimension data scenarios.

steps.title: If dimension data is missing, link the overfill indication to missing/incomplete dimension/weight data
steps.purpose: Provide the diagnostic conclusion the source supports: missing dimension data can make all shoots appear to overfill because fullness is computed from received dimensions/weight.
steps.instruction: When you confirm missing dimension data for the affected induct(s), document that the source explanation attributes the overfill indications to missing/incomplete dimension/weight data (not chute photo eyes/sensors).
steps.expected_result: Your diagnostic outcome states that the overfill/threshold behavior is consistent with missing dimension data for the sort induct/auto inducts.
steps.healthy_condition: The overfill symptom aligns with missing dimension data (e.g., after a power loss event where dimensioners 'vaulted out parcels' and dim data is not received).
steps.failure_condition: Dimension data is complete, yet overfill behavior persists (this should trigger escalation per the candidate).

actions.label: Record missing/incomplete dimension/weight as the cause
actions.exact_action: Document that missing dimension data can cause all the shoots to overfill because fullness uses weighted dimensions.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if dimension data appears complete yet overfill behavior persists (source provides only the missing-data explanation and no further corrective steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: 'they can see on their system that they're not getting dim data... all the shoots are overfilling' and explains fullness thresholds are computed from received dimension data scaled up/down.
Transcript includes: 'if totes overfill... we're not getting dimension data... happened that has a few weeks ago and they lost power. The dimensioners just vaulted out parcels'.

steps.title: Handle partial dimension data: confirm which fields are missing (e.g., second length, weight)
steps.purpose: The source provides an example of partial dimension data leading to overfill symptoms; capturing which fields are missing helps validate the mechanism.
steps.instruction: If dimension data is partially present, identify which specific dimension/weight components are missing (e.g., height/length present but second length missing; weight missing on other auto inducts).
steps.expected_result: You can describe the partial-data pattern that matches the source example and conclude it is consistent with overfill indications.
steps.healthy_condition: Partial dimension data is clearly identified (which fields are present vs missing) for the affected induct(s).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine whether data is partial vs complete, preventing a confident link to the source mechanism.

actions.label: Identify missing dimension/weight fields
actions.exact_action: Determine whether the system receives height/length but misses the second length, and whether weight is missing on other auto inducts.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: 'we were getting height, length, but not the second length. And then we missed weight on a different SO2 auto inducts...'.

success_criteria: You confirm that chute/tote fullness behavior is driven by received weight/dimensions (no photo eyes/sensors at the chute).
You determine whether dimension data is missing or incomplete for the relevant sort induct/auto inducts feeding the overfill symptom.
You produce a diagnostic conclusion linking overfill indications to missing/incomplete dimension/weight data, consistent with the source explanation.
healthy_conditions: Dimension data (weight and dimensions) is being received for the relevant induct(s), allowing fullness thresholds to be computed correctly.
Overfill indications do not occur when dimension data is complete (per the candidate’s escalation trigger logic).
failure_conditions: Dimension data is missing or incomplete, and overfill indications occur (source-supported failure mode).
Dimension data appears complete yet overfill behavior persists (candidate escalation trigger).
escalation_guidance: Escalate if dimension data appears complete yet overfill behavior persists, because the source only provides the missing-data explanation and does not provide further corrective steps.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Transcript statements about: (1) no photo eyes/sensors at the chute, (2) fullness determined from weighted dimensions, (3) missing dim data causing all shoots to overfill, and (4) partial dimension data example (height/length but missing second length; weight missing on other auto inducts).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: The source says there are no photo eyes/sensors; fullness uses weight and dimensions. If the system is not getting dimension data, chutes can appear to overfill.
